title: Chapter 442 The Strongest Of The Human Race
content:
Chapter 442 The Strongest Of The Human Race

The aura of the Supreme Realm of the Immortals is unconcealed.

A real strong man appeared.

The Holy Spirit Clan leader did not say anything nonsense and looked directly at the combat power list. The next moment, the Holy Spirit Clan leader disappeared from the spot and his name suddenly appeared on the combat power list.

Seeing the appearance of the Holy Spirit Clan leader, Mo Chou tickled.

At this time, the strong people of the human race silently gathered towards Mochou.

"Mr. Mochou, when will the Palace Master arrive?"

"Yes, this is the last day. If the Palace Master doesn't come, it's probably over."

"Let's not talk about the palace master for now. My human race is so big, why hasn't a top-notch man appeared?"

Listening to everyone's inquiry, Mo Chou patiently spread his hands, "Don't worry, this is where you go. Don't worry, in the end, it must be our human race to win the final victory."

Then, Mo Chou whispered to everyone: "The Lord of the Palace said he is going to make the finale."

"Do you understand?"

"Ao~"

Everyone nodded and then stopped asking.

Mo Chou chuckled, looked up at the list, his eyes widened, "Damn it, so quickly, it's time for me to keep the list."

At this time, the Holy Spirit Clan's patriarch was about to hit the top of the list, and his speed was extremely fast.

At the same time, in the Human Emperor Hall.

Wu Hui's pace was steady and he was slowly heading towards a forbidden area deep in the Human Emperor Hall.

Here, birds sing and flowers are fragrant, the air is fresh and the energy is rich. You can see at a glance that this is a place of retreat from a peerless powerful man.

I don’t know how long I left, but Wu Hui came to a forest.

And in front of Wu Hui, there was a very inconspicuous small thatched house.

"Senior Shi, are you still here?"

Wu Hui bowed slightly, his tone very respectful.

The next moment, an old voice came from the thatched room.

"Didn't I say that I can only disturb me when the human race is alive and dies."

"What? How long has it been since our human race reached the point of life and death?"

There was a whistle.

The straw curtain was lifted, and an old man with an old face and a strong body appeared in front of Wu Hui.

The old man's face was calm at this time, and he could not see any joy or anger.

Wu Hui chuckled, "Senior Shi, now in the Human Emperor Palace, you have the highest qualifications. I didn't want to ask you to come out of the mountain, but what if it's a big deal."

"Big, haha, I have never seen any storms and waves in the past few years."

Shi Zhong snorted lightly, but his eyes were fixed on Wu Hui.

He knew very well that since Wu Hui dared to call him, it was definitely not a simple matter.

"Senior Shi, I wonder if you still remember the gods?"

Gods.

Shi Zhong suddenly widened his eyes and blurted out: "Has the gods returned from sweeping over?"

"almost."

Wu Hui nodded slightly, "The source of the gods, the land of the gods, is about to invade the Chaos Realm."

"If I lose, countless creatures in my Chaos Realm will definitely encounter a catastrophe."

The atmosphere suddenly became much more depressed.

Shi Zhong's face was heavy and he paced back and forth in front of Wu Hui.

After a long time, Shi Zhong suddenly asked, "Is your master back?"

Wu Hui shook his head.

Shi Zhong frowned, "Your master is not coming back at this time."

"By the way, when did this happen?"

......

"What?! It's been so long, you're here to notify me now?!"

Shi Zhong's chest kept rising and falling, and he stared at Wu Hui, "Do you still have me in your eyes? When I joined the Human Emperor Palace, you didn't know where to put it!"

"Now, if you become the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, you think everything is under your control, right?"

"Why don't you wait for the land of the gods to hit my grass house and tell me?"

Feeling the spit in front of him flying around, Wu Hui calmly took out his handkerchief and wiped his face, and then said softly: "My master has not come back, but the first Lord of the Palace Master is back."

"who?"

Wu Hui said again: "The first Lord of the Palace, Lord Lu Xue."

At this time, in the prison of the human race.

"Who is this? This is the Heavenly Prison, and idle people cannot wait to enter!"

Two prison guards guarding the prison gate looked serious and scolded the strange man in front of him.

The man took out the token of the Human Emperor Palace indifferently and then entered the Heavenly Prison.

"Senior Fang, Lord Lord of the Palace asked me to inform you that you need to go there."

In a messy room in Tianzhuo.

A man with disheveled hair slowly raised his head and looked at the man through his long hair.

"Aren't I not allowed to step out of the prison for life?"

"Senior Fang, this is a special period."

Fang Qitian smiled and then lay flat on the ground. After a long time, he responded, "I understand."

......

"Senior Shi, don't you have to be so nervous, right?"

As soon as he entered the deserted city, Wu Hui noticed that Shi Zhong's hands were trembling slightly.

Hearing this, Shi Zhong whispered, "What do you know? I'm excited."

When Lu Xue first built the Human Emperor Palace, although he was not weak, he was a nameless person in the entire Human Emperor Palace. No one has ever noticed him.

But that's it, he seized the opportunity and used the huge resources brought by Lu Xue to quickly improve his strength and soon stood out.

Now, he is already an old senior who assists the three generations of palace masters.

"I really miss the days I used to do."

Shi Zhong smiled and suddenly burst into tears.

Seeing this, Wu Hui smiled and said, "Senior Shi, let's keep these tears in front of Lord Lu Xue before falling."

Upon hearing this, Shi Zhong nodded, "It makes sense."

The two of them did not go directly to the combat power list, but headed towards the city lord's mansion first.

"Two, Miss Lu Xue is not feeling well at this moment, so she may not see you. Please be mentally prepared."

"Huh? I'm not feeling well. What's wrong with Lord Lu Xue, this fellow Taoist?"

The guardian Huang Wei shook his head slightly, "I don't know very well. It seems that Miss Lu Xue's cultivation made a mistake and was backfired, which seems a bit serious."

Hearing this, Wu Hui and Shi Zhong looked at each other and were all feeling a little complicated.

It seems that the first Lord of the Palace Master was very uneasy about the war that was coming soon.

Don't worry, the first Lord of the Palace Master, we will definitely do our best to guard our home.

"Wu Hui is here? And Shi Zhong? Emm, let them come in."

Lu Xue shook her head and walked into the courtyard with a tired look.

Soon, two figures appeared in Lu Xue's vision.

"Lord Lu Xue."

"I have met the first Lord of the Palace."

Lu Xue looked at the two of them, then looked at Shi Zhong. After a long time, Lu Xue said, "Shi Zhong, I didn't expect you to be so old."

Upon hearing this, Shi Zhong was a little excited, "Mr. Palace Master, you are still as charming as ever."

Lu Xue chuckled and said, "Cherish this list. I can't tell you how long the Chaos Realm can last."

As he said that, Lu Xue looked at Wu Hui again, "Wu Hui, if you can't get the first place, you shouldn't sit down."

Hearing this, Wu Hui was stunned, but nodded and said, "Yes."
